about.desc: RingRouter is a self-hosted LLM API gateway: multi-protocol in/out, multi-channel routing with failover, passkey auth, subscription plans with group ratios — one binary to run.
about.f1: Four inbound protocols, any-to-any (OpenAI / Responses / Claude / Gemini). Any compatible client just works.
about.f2: Multi-channel routing: model matching, priority ordering, automatic failover; keys sealed at rest.
about.f3: Groups & subscriptions: grants apply instantly, ratio-based billing, snapshot subscription lifecycle.
about.f4: Passkey passwordless sign-in — private keys never leave your device.
about.f5: Single-binary deploy: embedded frontend, one-command Docker Compose with PostgreSQL + Redis.
